name: Meltwater
description: The Meltwater MCP server connects AI tools and workflows to Meltwater’s media and social intelligence. Search billions of news articles and social posts, retrieve live metrics, trends, and sentiment, generate Boolean queries, and manage saved searches — all through natural language. Requires an active Meltwater subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Meltwater to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Meltwater to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.meltwater.com/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Meltwater MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meltwater provides these MCP tools: explore_plus_list_searches, listening_create_search, listening_delete_search, listening_get_search, listening_list_filter_sets, listening_list_searches, listening_update_search, unified_retrieval_document_retrieval_tool, unified_retrieval_query_gen_tool, and unified_retrieval_statistics_retrieval_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Meltwater?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Meltwater in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Meltwater requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Meltwater is developed by Meltwater. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
